title: Breast Feeding Tracker Privacy Policy
htmlContent:
Breast Feeding Tracker is designed to support parents with simple feeding logs while respecting privacy.

Data Collection

Feeding entries and related tracking details are stored locally on your device. The advertising information described below is processed separately from your feeding records.

How Data Is Used

Your feeding information is used to provide timeline history, summaries, and in-app insights for you. We do not send your feeding records to Kickstart Exchange.

Advertising: Kickstart Exchange

The free version of Breast Feeding Tracker uses the Kickstart Exchange SDK to display adverts for other independent apps. Kickstart Exchange is operated by Hudson Heavy Industries Ltd.

To deliver adverts, check compatibility, measure app promotion, and protect the service from misuse, the SDK sends information about the app: its integration key, bundle identifier, platform, app and build versions, SDK version, and App Store country. The country comes from your App Store account’s storefront setting, not GPS location.

Kickstart Exchange records advert displays, clicks, and any advert reports you submit. These are app-level advertising and product-interaction records, rather than records linked to your identity. Tapping an advert opens the advertised app’s App Store page.

In release builds, the SDK may also send an Apple-signed App Transaction to verify a genuine installation. This can contain stable transaction and device-verification values. Kickstart states that it uses this signed evidence only for verification and immediately discards it, without retaining or using those values to identify, profile, or target you.

Kickstart’s network provider, Cloudflare, processes your IP address to deliver and secure requests, including advert artwork. Kickstart states that it does not store these addresses or use them to identify users.

Kickstart retains individual app-level advert delivery and interaction records for approximately 30 days. Aggregate daily app-to-app statistics are retained without a fixed deletion date. These statistics do not identify individual users or devices.

For further details, read the Kickstart Exchange privacy notice.

Sharing and Tracking

Breast Feeding Tracker does not sell your feeding records or use them to personalise adverts. Kickstart Exchange states that it does not track users across apps or websites or build behavioural profiles.

Your Choices

Lifetime Unlock removes Kickstart Exchange advert banners from the app. You can purchase or restore Lifetime Unlock in the app.

You can remove your tracking data by deleting entries in the app or uninstalling the app, depending on feature availability.

Contact

If you have any questions, contact support@scruffyhipster.com.
